title: physics: construct and classify pair-factor QND Record writer
science: The microscopic route designed to FIX the Block-18 rate underselection is constructed and STILL fails to fix it — a forcing negative one level deeper. Positive half: an explicit local repeated-interaction writer, PAIR-FACTOR-QND-WEAK-COLLISION-REALIZES-PERMANENT-RECORD-GENERATOR. On an auxiliary seven-state pointer, the relation-factor Hamiltonian H_x = sum_f (A_(x,f)+h.c.) with A_(x,f) = g|f><blank|_x tensor |f><0|_anc times prod_y [P_(y,blank) + a P_(y,f) + b P_(y,other(f))] has an exact rank-two bright block (characteristic polynomial lambda^5(lambda^2-h), H^3 = hH), giving closed-form Kraus operators K_0 = P_rec + cos(sqrt(delta h))P_blank and K_f = -i (c_f/sqrt h) sin(sqrt(delta h))|f><blank|, exact trace preservation, target lock (K_0 P_rec = P_rec, K_f P_rec = 0), neighbor-label conservation [H_x,P_(y,g)]=0, and a weak-limit range-one append-only pure-Record Lindblad generator. Negative half: a COMPLETE positive-real classification (not two handpicked members) — matching the supplied kernel 2^(m_f)/Z forces kappa=(a/b)^2=2 necessarily and sufficiently, but leaves beta=b^2 free after quotienting the global rate scale g^2, with q_f = g^2 beta^n kappa^(m_f). Two different betas are NOT related by any global rescaling since h_beta/h_beta prime = (beta prime/beta)^n varies with recorded-neighbor count. A same-Z discriminator (x_2: n=2, two same-label neighbors, Z=9; x_3: n=3, distinct labels, Z=9) gives P(x_3 first) = beta/(1+beta) = 1/2 at beta=1 and 2/3 at beta=2 — dimensionless, with the common g^2 and Z=9 cancelling and the exterior-history survival factor S_H(s) cancelling before or after averaging. Terminal PAIR-FACTOR-QND-WEAK-COLLISION-REALIZES-MARK-KERNEL-RECORDED-NEIGHBOR-GAIN-UNDERSELECTED. Also corrects the earlier n=0 vs n=6 fixture to a hostile control (its odds are 2beta^6/(1+2beta^6), not 1/2 and 2/3), and proves the sweep-order regulator does not select the generator (leading differences +delta^2/6 at beta=1, -5delta^2/12 at the control beta=1/2; the delta coefficient is zero).
